title: Mooses Full Bright
description: A client-side Fabric mod that keeps caves and nighttime bright.
body: Full Bright is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that keeps your game bright in dark areas. Caves, nighttime, and unlit spaces become easy to see without changing actual world lighting. It does not affect mob spawning, servers, redstone, crops, or what other players see. Press B to toggle Full Bright on or off anytime.
